summary: Digital Brands Group filed an 8-K regarding a Lock-Up and Leak-Out Agreement with the holder of a majority of its Series D Convertible Preferred Stock, entered as inducement for resetting the Floor Price on the preferred stock via a Certificate of Amendment. The lock-up restricts the holder from selling common stock for 180 days, except for daily sales up to 3% of trading volume. The Floor Price reset defines a new minimum conversion price based on 20% of recent closing prices. This filing reflects a negotiated equity-linked financing adjustment, not a standard M&A or restructuring event. What to watch: potential dilution impact and stock price dynamics during the restricted period.
